### Identifying Fruit
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/identifying-fruit-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 7:17-18
Points:
- Outward fruit inevitably reveals the true inner nature of a person's heart.
- Examining spiritual fruit is necessary spiritual discernment rather than judgmental condemnation.
- Ongoing, unrepentant sinful living indicates an imposter whose heart belongs to the world.
- Believers should examine their own lives to see if they display the Holy Spirit's fruit.

### Fruit Inspection
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/print/B140212/fruit-inspection
Passage: Matthew 7:16-20
Points:
- Jesus gives fruit inspection as the reliable standard to identify deceptive false teachers.
- Outward appearance and external religious roles cannot permanently conceal a corrupt internal nature.
- True spiritual fruit begins in the heart and inevitably manifests in godly attitudes and deeds.
- A genuine believer demonstrates true humility and meekness born of saving grace.
